about: Rides into a castle or town of your realm or an ally to cash in. In a town he sells his loot, as far as the town's purse goes: weapons, armour, shields, ammunition, harness and plunder, never food, horses, pack animals, herds, books or banners. In a castle or a town he hands his prisoners over for their ransom. The gold goes into his own purse. Then he is free, or starts his next order. A lord holding any of your orders sells his loot the same way whenever he rides into a friendly town; this order sends him to do it now.
calls_back: it has cashed in, with what it got

go.about: riding to {at} to sell his loot and prisoners
